title: Why She Took the DPA Out of the BDC | Break the Routine with Hannah Trever
description:
Hannah Trever started dancing at four, joined the Dance Promotions Association as treasurer, and was told by her own committee, without warning, that she would be its next chair. Now in her second year, she tells Marius Iepure why the DPA is no longer part of the BDC, what it means to stand completely alone with its own system, licences and members, and why she believes it was the right move for the dancers.

She opens up about being underestimated as a woman in a male-dominated industry, people calling her husband Duncan instead of the chairman, and leading even when the decision is not the popular one. Plus safeguarding and confidential reporting, why you keep seeing the same judging panels, the £5 membership, the national league, and what UK DanceSport governance still gets wrong about transparency.

An honest conversation about leadership, change and the courage to take the risk.

Episode out now on YouTube.
